{{Taurus}}

Taurus is the 6th month of the [[Gaian calendar]]. It contains 28 days (4 weeks) and corresponds to ISO weeks 21–24.

== Overview ==
===Etymology===
English ''Taurus'' "bull" (Latin). Japanese: {{ill|牡牛座|ja|Oushi-za}} “bull-constellation.”  
===Gaiad themes===
Weeks 21–24 (Days [[Taurus 1]]–[[Taurus 28]]): maturing terrestrial ecosystems, forests and riverscapes, and synoptic chapters on balance and exchange.  
===EVENTS===
* [[Taurus 7]] — Pentecost  
* [[Taurus 28]] — Dragon Boat Festival
